title: Email Campaigns
notes: Rebuilt onto ListPage/DetailPage/EntityForm archetypes. Detail page now reads real sentCount/deliveredCount/openedCount/clickedCount fields and a live paginated recipients table (no mock data). Added edit page (desktop/src/app/(app)/campaigns/[id]/edit/page.tsx) wired to the previously-orphaned PUT /campaigns/:id; delete row action wired to DELETE. List export pages through the full filtered dataset client-side as CSV (no dedicated /exports/campaigns backend endpoint exists). detailDrawer intentionally false — this slice uses a dedicated detail page/route (contract-sanctioned alternative to onRowClick navigation) rather than a drawer. sendMessageDialog/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput are not applicable — campaigns has no phone/address/currency fields and outbound sending goes through the campaign send/schedule API, not ad-hoc messaging.
showcaseScript: Open Campaigns and filter by status
Create an email campaign targeting a segment
Schedule it and show the recipient list
Open a sent campaign and read its open and click rates
